coverage.reason: No UI primitives or menus change; this fixes server bot navigation.
Short jump and approach state is transient and clears through existing lifecycle resets.
No admission, privileges, credentials or server action validation changes.
Existing authority movement snapshots remain unchanged.
ServerBotController must retain the shared 96 expansion and 2 millisecond navigation budget.
Existing player controls and observer controls remain unchanged.
Real controller and pickup physics reproduce narrow-gap case failure and low-obstacle traversal; a focused brain test reproduces airborne braking.
Short traversal keeps an explicit landing target separate from grounded route planning.

direct.name: cannon-es
direct.compatibility: The existing locked game controller already uses cannon-es 0.20.0.
direct.ownership: BotNavigation validates close case approaches and bounded jump landing/clearance; ObjectiveBotBrain retains airborne intent; ServerBotController and ChaosSimulation retain movement and pickup authority.

behavior.behavior: Explicit off-mesh traversal state retains start/end positions until the transition completes instead of treating an airborne agent as ordinary grounded walking. Rat Detective retains a short landing target and uses its existing physics.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy source, replace the navigation stack or alter movement physics.

platform.requirement: A Durable Object is single-threaded and CPU-limited. Retain the existing shared 2 ms / 96 expansion navigation budget instead of solving every bot route synchronously.
